svg.title: P08: Multi-provider transport abstraction collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1 · bridge role collaboration
A harness can select among model backends.
The runtime resolves or invokes a model provider.
Backends are interchangeable through a declared
capability errors map to explicit types.
1 request(call) → 2 resolve(provider) → 3 map(request) → 4 invoke(request) → 5 return(response) → 6 return(result_or_error)
Evidence: 31/41 repositories, 28/36 families; 31 trajectories (18 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Registry, factory, adapter, transport, retry advice, and capability discovery.
Negative control: A single hard-coded vendor client is not the abstraction.
